preconditions.description: Number of parcels is between 1 and 500.
Strength of the platform is between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ini < outi < 2*n for ini, outi, _, _, _ in parcels)
preconditions.description: For each parcel, arrival time is less than departure time, and both are within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi, si <= 1000 for _, _, wi, si, _ in parcels)
preconditions.description: Weight and strength of each parcel are between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= 10**6 for _, _, _, _, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: Value of each parcel is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of bourles Jaroslav can get.
